description: This file implements the 'Library' class, which manages dynamic library loading, symbol resolution, reference counting, and cleanup for a cross-platform application. It includes platform-specific code for Windows and Linux to handle dynamic libraries and their functions.

classes.name: Library
classes.description: A class that encapsulates dynamic library loading, symbol resolution, reference counting, and cleanup for cross-platform use.

methods.name: Library
methods.description: Default constructor initializing internal handles and error state.

methods.description: Constructs a Library object by loading the library containing the specified function pointer.

methods.name: Library(const TCHAR fileName[])
methods.description: Constructs a Library object by loading a library from a filename.

methods.description: Copy constructor that increases reference count.

methods.description: Loads a function symbol from the loaded library.

methods.description: Increments the reference count for the library handle.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and unloads the library if count reaches zero.
